_note: #252 generics blocklist: generic CATEGORY names that are not a specific entity, emitted as the additive entities.json `is_generic` flag (SPS family_entity.is_generic). It is a FLAG, never a drop — SPS soft-suppresses flagged rows (renders them non-clickable) so a non-specific bucket ('antibody', 'CT scanner', 'electronic health records', 'logistic regression') can't drive a non-specific feed. Matched WHOLE-WORD against norm_name(display_name) AND only when the name carries NO distinctive digit-bearing designator (the _HAS_DIGIT guard) — so a specific digit-coded entity (3T3-L1, HEK293T, PHQ-9, AAV9) is never flagged even if its name contains a generic head noun. The list is GLOBAL/kind-agnostic; with the broadened entity scope (is_projectable_family: all kinds except method/assay) it now spans every projected kind, grouped by ordering below: cell-line (original 13), then organism_or_cells, dataset, reagent, instrument, software, model. DELIBERATELY OMITTED to protect specific entities (do NOT re-add): bare 'cell line'/'cell lines'/'cancer cell lines' (flag HNSCC/TNBC/DIPG cell lines); bare 'mouse' AND bare 'mice' (flag specific strains NSG/NOG/SCID/Balb-c/db-db — keep only the qualified forms 'knockout mice'/'wild-type mice'/etc.); the stem-cell category terms iPSC/hESC/hPSC/mESC (re-classify existing live cell-line entities); 'comorbidity index' (flags the distinguishing Charlson CCI); 'in vivo'/'in vitro' (condition modifiers that bleed into 'in vivo imaging' etc.); 'state inpatient databases' (catches the specific HCUP SID, not a broad category). KNOWN ACCEPTED BLEED (soft-suppress only, ~1.5% of flagged, mostly usage<=1): a brand-prefixed name whose generic head noun is listed can be flagged — e.g. a brand instrument ('Leica confocal microscope' via 'microscope'), 'MEDLINE/PubMed bibliographic database' (deliberately suppressed as non-distinguishing literature infrastructure), brand EHR products ('Flatiron ... electronic medical record'). Operator-curated/extendable, fail-open (missing file -> none flagged). Digit-free specific names (MDCK, HeLa, SEER, REDCap) are protected simply by not appearing here.
